title: Application Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Application Tech Support Practitioner  

**Project Role Description :** Act as the ongoing interface between the client and the system or application. Dedicated to quality, using exceptional communication skills to keep our world class systems running. Can accurately define a client issue and can interpret and design a resolution based on deep product knowledge.
  

**Must have skills :** Infrastructure Service Management  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Application Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves serving as the continuous liaison between clients and the system or application environment. This role is committed to maintaining high standards of quality by utilizing excellent communication to ensure the smooth operation of advanced systems. The practitioner carefully identifies client issues and applies thorough understanding of the product to develop effective solutions, ensuring client satisfaction and system reliability throughout daily interactions and problem resolution processes.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Coordinate cross\-functional efforts to streamline support processes and enhance service delivery.
* Mentor junior team members to foster skill development and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues to minimize downtime.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Infrastructure Service Management.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities with a focus on system and application support.
* Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with clients and internal teams.
* Experience in incident management and root cause analysis within IT operations.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Familiarity with service management frameworks and best practices.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Infrastructure Service Management.


\- This position is based at our HDC4 \- SEZ location.  

* A 15 years full time education is required.

description:

==================


Cubic Transportation Systems**Company Details:**
====================


When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

================

**Job Summary:** The IT Monitoring Administrator is responsible for ensuring the reliability and health of the Operational Support System (OSS), ensuring incidents and events are managed within agreed service level agreements (SLAs) and escalated appropriately. In addition, they will promote and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and knowledge sharing with the team.

* Maintain register of monitors and system design documentation.

* Contribute to knowledge base articles.

* Provide analysis of capacity management to assist other resolver teams.
* Provide Windows Server support as required.

 **Essential**

* Degree, or equivalent years of relevant experience in a technical or technical management discipline.
* Two (2\)\+ years of experience in Microsoft System Centre suite, Prometheus, App Dynamics, SolarWinds Orion, and Microsoft Azure/AWS platforms.
* Experience supporting customers within a technical capacity.
* Formal training with a Monitoring product.
* A self\-starter who can drive through change at all levels, recognized by their peers as inspirational and the go\-to person for solving organizational problems.
* Motivation to improve skillset to ensure we are challenging system design.
* Excellent attention to detail and an unfaltering desire to deliver exceptional service.
* Customer\-focused and comfortable with dealing with executive\-level managers.
* Able to prioritize multiple tasks with deftness and adhere to deadlines.
* Strong analytical and influencing skills to assess demand for change and ensure that the necessary controls are in place to deliver successfully.

 **Desirable**

* Networking, Unix, or Microsoft qualifications.
* Experience of using SCSM 2012 in a corporate environment.
* Experience in scripting in PowerShell in a corporate environment.
* Experience working within an IT Helpdesk.
* Up\-to\-date understanding of cloud technologies (AWS/Azure).

title: IT Helpdesk Analyst
description:
As an Associate Engineer – Workforce Support L1, you will provide first\-level technical support to Verisk employees for technology\-related incidents and service requests.


You will troubleshoot common IT issues, document resolutions, ensure requests are handled within SLA timelines, and escalate complex issues to higher\-level support teams when required. This is an entry\-level role suitable for candidates looking to build a career in IT support and infrastructure.


  
* Provide Level 1 technical support for employee\-reported IT incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot basic hardware, software, operating system, network, and connectivity issues.
* Log, track, prioritize, and resolve support requests within established SLA guidelines.
* Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and relevant technical information accurately.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate technical support teams.
* Provide professional and timely support to employees and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, engineering, operations, and other technology teams when required.
* Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, and troubleshooting guides.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to improve service quality and operational efficiency.

  
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* No previous professional experience required; fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP and OSI network layers.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and customer\-service skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented and fast\-paced environment.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously develop technical skills.

title: IT Quality Specialist - Pharma R&D
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

The IT Quality Specialist independently manages the end\-to\-end quality and analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to solving moderately complex business problems. You will lead the analysis of stakeholders needs, drive root cause analysis, and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability across large\-scale initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will champion accountability, mentor junior team members, and drive process improvements that align delivered solutions with overarching business goals.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and UX Designers, to define scope, solutions, constraints, and project risks.
* Manage compliance documentation processes and systems, characterizing business solutions for compliance with internal and external regulations.
* Be accountable for the creation and maintenance of:
* System Risk Assessments and Data Classification Reports.
* User Requirements and Functional/Technical Specifications.
* Validation Plans, Reports, and Registries.
* Requirements Traceability Matrices, Test Plans, and Test Reports.
* Data/Process flow diagrams and training documentation.
* Configure system settings and provide consultation to customers regarding solution enhancements and new implementations.
* Facilitate UAT planning and execution.
* Serve as a trusted partner for Global Privacy, IT Security, and Business Quality teams, maintaining expert\-level knowledge of governance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485\).
* Drive the resolution of business or systems issues throughout the project lifecycle.
* Enhance the creation and maintenance of compliance documentation (e.g., System Risk Assessments, Validation Plans, Requirements Traceability Matrices) by leveraging AI\-driven automation to reduce manual effort while maintaining compliance rigor.
* Implement AI\-assisted quality control tools to automate data validation, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform consistency checks, ensuring sustained data integrity and adherence to GxP/CSV standards at scale.
* Utilize AI\-powered analytical tools to monitor platform performance, proactively identify process bottlenecks, and generate audit\-ready compliance metrics.
* Guide the strategic deployment of AI agents within the IT Quality landscape, ensuring that AI\-assisted workflows remain compliant by design and effectively support business requirements.


Experience Profile
  
  

* 7\-10 years of related experience in an IT business systems analyst or IT quality assurance role.
* Strong domain knowledge of the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, manufacturing/quality assurance processes, and computer systems validation (CSV).
* Proven understanding of application development methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), including functional requirements, process modeling, and large\-scale system implementations.
* BA/BS degree in life science, informatics, business, or equivalent (MA/MS or post\-graduate coursework is a plus).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships, focus on the customer, and solve complex problems in fast\-paced environments.
* Strong capability to independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.
* Ability to champion accountability by example, drive process improvement initiatives, and mentor junior team members.


\#Hyderabad2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

title: Jr. Desktop Support Engineer
description:
At Meazure Learning, we aim to empower open\-minded, inquisitive, and driven people, and we love how each new addition to the team adds to our culture. Here, you can positively impact the careers of millions of test\-takers and reshape the education technology landscape by working toward one vision:


“To provide life\-long learners across the globe the freedom to pursue their academic dreams and career aspirations safely, securely, and conveniently.”


Our Vision starts with our values—Hungry, Humble and Smart. We are looking for team members who model drive for results. Team members who think of the organization and team first without ego or agenda. Leaders who instinctively collaborate and operate with emotional intelligence. This is the foundation of success for all employees at Meazure Learning.

**The Role:**


We are looking for a motivated and tech\-savvy individual to join our IT team as a Jr. Desktop Support Engineer. The Desktop Support Engineer will be responsible for providing technical assistance and support to end\-users, ensuring that all desktop systems, hardware, software, and peripheral devices function efficiently.

**The Responsibilities:**

* Provide Technical Support: Assist in troubleshooting and resolving hardware and software issues on desktops, laptops, and other devices.
* Installation and Configuration: Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, software applications, and hardware peripherals.
* User Assistance: Respond to user inquiries and provide support via phone, email, or in\-person to resolve technical issues promptly.
* System Maintenance: Perform regular maintenance tasks, including system updates, backups, and patch management.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, and hardware/software inventories.
* Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest technology trends, software updates, and industry best practices.

**Additional Position Information:**

* Onsite
* Location: HYDW
* Core Hours: Rotational Shift
* Core Days Worked: To be determined

**The Desired Attributes:**

* **The Desired Attributes:**
	+ **Education**: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
	+ **Experience**: Fresher
	+ **Technical Skills**:
* + Knowledge in Windows and macOS operating systems.
	+ Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and other common software applications.
	+ Experience with hardware troubleshooting and repair.
	+ Familiarity with network concepts and troubleshooting
	+ Understanding of Active Directory.
	+ **Soft Skills**:
* + Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
	+ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	+ Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	+ Customer\-oriented approach with a focus on delivering high\-quality support**Working Conditions:**


	+ Office environment with occasional requirements for on\-site support.
	+ Ability to lift and move computer equipment as needed.
	+ Availability for occasional after\-hours support and on\-call duties.

**The Benefits:**

* Competitive Pay
* Healthy work Culture
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Learning and Development Opportunities
* Company Sponsored Health Insurance
* Referral Award Program


Learn more at www.meazurelearning.com
